name: zindex_archive_flush_index_to_tail
description: zIndexArchive::FlushIndexToTail appends the record table and {magic=1, recordCount} trailer to the archive file, then clears the dirty flag.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the zReader pool helper source target.
The native smoke forces dirty close, validates the written file size and trailer, and confirms the dirty flag is cleared.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4a6360 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs after 8 relocation-masked bytes; BN size 129, VC object symbol size 144, 15 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
